verses.text: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

segments.text: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue
the pen of a ready writer.

notes: 45.1 is inditing: Heb. boileth, or, bubbleth up

verses.text: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

segments.text: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

verses.text: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

segments.text: mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

verses.text: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

segments.text: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness
righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

notes: 45.4 ride…: Heb. prosper thou, ride thou

verses.text: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.

segments.text: sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies;

verses.text: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.

segments.text: for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom

verses.text: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

segments.text: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

verses.text: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

segments.text: cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

verses.text: Kings’ daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

segments.text: among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

verses.text: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house;

segments.text: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house;

verses.text: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.

segments.text: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he
thy Lord; and worship thou him.

verses.text: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.

segments.text: the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.

verses.text: The king’s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.

segments.text: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.

verses.text: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king’s palace.

segments.text: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king’s palace.

verses.text: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

segments.text: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

verses.text: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

segments.text: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

headings.text: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, for the sons of Korah, Maschil, A Song of loves.
